correctness.rationale: The smooth plane quartic has genus 3. Three explicit separable degree-two quotient maps are algebraically verified, and the three independent character eigenspaces give a 2-primary Jacobian isogeny. For odd p this preserves p-divisible groups. The binary-quartic j invariants calculate to 1728,8000,1728, with CM discriminants -4,-8,-4. Deuring inert-prime criterion gives supersingular elliptic counts 0/2/1/3 for p residues 1/3/5/7; p-ranks are complementary. Exact Hasse-Witt rank checks for 15 primes confirm the four classes. Finite tests are only corroboration.

value.rationale: This naturally defined genus-three Chebyshev quartic is directly singled out in recent geometry and automorphism research. The theorem gives an exact arithmetic classification at every odd prime: ordinary, two distinct mixed a-number strata, and superspecial, with explicit degree-two quotient geometry. The result is not an arbitrary finite sample or restatement of a j-invariant, and gives full p-rank behavior beyond maximality statements.
